# Azure region short codes (naming convention)

Use the short code as the `<region>` segment in resource names (`hp-avd-lab-sec`).

| Region | Short code |
|---|---|
| swedencentral | sec |
| westeurope | weu |
| northeurope | neu |
| uksouth | uks |
| eastus | eus |
| eastus2 | eus2 |
| westus2 | wus2 |
| centralus | cus |
| australiaeast | aue |
| southeastasia | sea |

Default region for this MicroHack: **swedencentral (sec)** — set via `$AZURE_DEFAULTS_LOCATION`.
Pick a region close to the learner if Sweden Central lacks quota; keep the short code consistent.
